day_local: UMvulo weVeki yeShamashumi amabini anesixhenxe ngexesha eliqhelekileyo
greeting: Egameni likaYise, nelikaNyana, nelikaMoya oyiNgcwele. Uxolo lweNkosi uYesu Kristu malube nani nonke.
penitential: Nkosi, siye saphambuka endleleni yakho, sicele inceba. Kristu, uze usiphilise, sicele inceba. Nkosi, sikhanyisele ngothando lwakho, sicele inceba.
psalm_response: INkosi iya kukhumbula umnqophiso wayo ngonaphakade.
homily:
Cinga ngomzuzu apho uBenjamin Vo, esesemncinci, ehlala phantsi phambi kwekhompyutha yakhe, ebhala iikhowudi zokudala umdlalo omtsha okanye ecwangcisa indlela i-'con chim airlines' yakhe eya kubhabha ngayo. Kwakukho ukuzimisela okukhulu emehlweni akhe, ukuzimisela okungazange kwabangelwa kukufuna ukubonwa ngabantu, kodwa ngenxa yokuba wayeyithanda inyaniso yento awayeyenza. Wayengumfana owayethanda ukwakha, ukudala, nokuzisa uvuyo. Namhlanje, kwiNcwadi kaGalati, uPawulos uthi: 'Am ndizama ngoku ukufumana ubabalo lwabantu, okanye olukaThixo? Okanye ndifuna ukukholisa abantu?' Umpostile usikhumbuza ukuba ubomi bethu abuyiyo imidlalo yokukholisa abantu, kodwa bubudlelwane obunzulu noKristu.

KwiVangeli, uYesu udibana nomntu owayefuna ukumvavanya ngombuzo othi: 'Ndingenza ntoni ukuze ndizuze ubomi obungunaphakade?' UYesu akamniki impendulo enzima, kodwa umbuza: 'Uthini umthetho?' Xa lo mntu ephendula ngokuthanda uThixo nommelwane, uYesu uthi: 'Yenza oko, uya kuphila.' Kodwa lo mntu, efuna ukuzithethelela, ubuza: 'Ngubani ke ummelwane wam?' Apha, uYesu ubalisa ibali lomSamariya olungileyo. Le ndoda ayizange ibuze ukuba umntu owayebethwe ecaleni kwendlela wayengubani. Ayizange ibuze ukuba wayeluhlanga luni na. Yabona intlungu. Yabona inxeba. Yabona ubomi obusengozini. Yaza, ngaphandle kokulibazisa, yenza imfesane.

Alan noThao, ndiyazi ukuba iinyanga ezintathu ezi zidlulileyo bezinzima kakhulu. Ndiyazi ukuba kukho amaxesha apho intliziyo iziva ngathi iyaphuka, xa ucinga ngaloo mntwana owayeza kuwe, owayekuthanda, owayekujonga ngamehlo anothando. Usizi alulandeli ikhalenda. Luza ngexesha lalo, lunzima, lufuna indawo. Ndaye ndifuna ukuba uthethe inyaniso yale ntliziyo yakho namhlanje. Akukho nqaku lokuthi uphosile okanye wenze kakubi. Ukugula akwanga kwenzeka ngenxa yezinto owazenzayo okanye ongazenzanga. UThixo akakubeki icala, kwaye noBen akakubeki icala. Masikhuphe lo mthwalo wokuzisola emajukujukwini eentliziyo zenu namhlanje. Awuphosanga nto. Ubenze konke okusemandleni enu ngothando olungapheliyo. Ezinye izinto zenzeka ngaphandle kolawulo lwethu, ngaphandle kokuba nabani na enze impazamo. Niyinyaniso, nithandwa nguThixo.

Khumbula indlela uBen awayenentliziyo enobubele ngayo. Khumbula loo mzuzu xa wayefuna ukunikela ngayo yonke imali yakhe yasebhange encinci ukuze ancede umalume wakhe uWilliam owayehlaselwe zizifo. Akazange ayiphule loo ngulube yemali, akazange ayikhuphule ngokoqobo, kodwa isipho sasingaphakathi entliziyweni yakhe. Wayengumfana owayenokunikela ngayo yonke into yakhe ngaphandle kokubala. Wayengumfana owayephila ngoxolo lukaKristu. WayengumSamariya olungileyo ebomini bakhe, ebonisa uthando olungenamiqathango.

Ryan, mfowethu omncane, uBen uyamthanda. Ungalokothi uzive ungedwa. UBen uyaqhubeka ehamba nawe, ekukhathalele, kwaye uthando lwenu aluzange lufe. Vumela uYesu abe lulwalwa lwakho namhlanje. Thatha igama likaBen, thandaza kuye uThixo, kwaye uqhubeke uphila ngesibindi, wazi ukuba akukho lizwi linye lothando olulahlekileyo phambi koThixo. UBen uyaqhubeka ekhanya ngomsebenzi wakhe wothando, njengaloo mthombo wamanzi eCà Mau, olethela ubomi kwabanye. Uthando lwakhe aluzange luphele; lusaqhubeka lukhanya njengolwandle olukhulu.

UYesu uthi: 'Hamba, wenze njalo.' Lo ngumyalelo wethu namhlanje. Hamba, uthande njengokuba uBen wayethanda. Hamba, ube nomfesane njengokuba uBen wayenaye. Hamba, ube nentliziyo evulekileyo njengokuba uBen wayenayo. Xa uziva usizi, yithi: 'Nkosi, ndiyakuthanda, kwaye ndiyakuthemba.' UBen uyaqhubeka esidumisela kuThixo. Uthando lwenu luyaqhubeka luhleli, lusaqhubeka lukhula, kwaye uBen uyaqhubeka ekhanya. Benjamin, lala ngokuthula. Uthando lwakho lulukhanya olungasoze lwavaleleka. Siya kukukhumbula njalo, side sidibane kwakhona apho kungekho nyembezi, apho kukho uvuyo olungunaphakade. Amen.
spiritual_communion: Nkosi yam uYesu, ndiyakholwa ukuba ukhona kwiSakramente eliNgcwele. Ndiyakuthanda ngaphezu kwako konke, kwaye ndinqwenela ukukwamkela emphefumlweni wam. Ekubeni ndingenakukwamkela ngoku kwiSakramente, nceda uze kum ngomoya. Ndiyakwamkela njengokungathi sele ufikile, ndizidibanise nawe ngokupheleleyo. Ungaze undivumele ndahluke kuwe. Amen.
closing: INkosi mayisikelele, isigcine, kwaye isiphe uxolo lwayo olungapheliyo. Amen.
standing_petitions: Sithandazela uBen nabo bonke abasishiyileyo, ukuze baphumle elukhanyeni lukaKristu.
Sithandazela bonke abasentlungwini, ukuze uThixo abathuthuzele abanike ithemba.

readings.label: Isifundo sokuqala
readings.text: Bazalwana, ndiyamangala ukuba niphambuka ngokukhawuleza kulo onibize ngobabalo lukaKristu, nisiya kwiindaba ezimnandi ezahlukileyo; kanti azikho ezinye. Kodwa kukho abaniphazamisayo, befuna ukuzijika iindaba ezimnandi zikaKristu. Kodwa nokuba thina okanye ingelosi evela ezulwini inganivakalisa iindaba ezimnandi ezahlukileyo kwezo sanishumayeza zona, mayibe phantsi kwesiqalekiso! Njengoko sitshilo ngaphambili, ndiphinda nditsho ngoku: ukuba kukho nabani na onishumayeza iindaba ezimnandi ezahlukileyo kwezo nazamkelayo, mayibe phantsi kwesiqalekiso! Ngaba ndizama ngoku ukufumana ubabalo lwabantu, okanye olukaThixo? Okanye ndifuna ukukholisa abantu? Ukuba ndandingasazama ukukholisa abantu, ngendingenguye umkhonzi kaKristu. Kodwa ndifuna nazi, bazalwana, ukuba iindaba ezimnandi endazishumayelayo aziveli ebantwini. Kuba andizange ndizamkele ebantwini, ndingazange ndifundiswe zizo, kodwa ndizamkele ngesityhilelo sikaYesu Kristu.

readings.label: INdumiso
readings.text: Ndiza kubulela eNkosini ngayo yonke intliziyo yam, phakathi kwendibano yamalungisa. Mkhulu imisebenzi yeNkosi, imnandi kwabo bayithandayo. Imisebenzi yezandla zayo ithembekile kwaye ilungile; yonke imithetho yayo inyanisekile. Imi ngonaphakade kanaphakade, yenziwe ngenyaniso nangobulungisa. Ithumele ukuhlangulwa ebantwini bayo; imise umnqophiso wayo ngonaphakade; lingcwele kwaye liyoyikeka igama layo. Udumo lwayo luhlala ngonaphakade.

readings.label: IVangeli
readings.text: Kwavela umfundisi womthetho, wema ukuze amvavanye uYesu, wathi: 'Mfundisi, ndimele ndenze ntoni ukuze ndizuze ubomi obungunaphakade?' UYesu wathi kuye: 'Kubhaliwe ntoni emthethweni? Ufunda uthini?' Waphendula wathi: 'Uze uyithande iNkosi uThixo wakho ngayo yonke intliziyo yakho, nangomphefumlo wakho wonke, nangamandla akho onke, nangengqondo yakho yonke, nommelwane wakho njengokuba uzithanda wena.' Wathi kuye: 'Uphendule ngokuchanekileyo; yenza oko, uya kuphila.' Kodwa ngenxa yokuba wayefuna ukuzithethelela, wathi kuYesu: 'Ngubani ke ummelwane wam?' UYesu waphendula wathi: 'Indoda ethile yayihla ivela eJerusalema isiya eJeriko, yawa ezandleni zamasela. Ayamvuza, yamwisa, yemka imshiya eselefa. Kwathi umbingeleli othile wayehla ngaloo ndlela, kodwa akumbona, wadlula ngakwelinye icala. Kwangokunjalo umLevi wafika kuloo ndawo, akumbona, wadlula ngakwelinye icala. Kodwa umSamariya othile ohambahambayo wafika kuye, waba nemfesane akumbona. Wasondela kuye, wathulula ioyile newayini kumanxeba akhe, wawabopha. Wamkhwelisa esilwanyaneni sakhe, wamusa endlwini yeendwendwe, wamnyamekela. Ngengomso wakhupha iingqekembe ezimbini zesilivere, wazinika umnini-ndlu wathi: "Mnyamekele. Ukuba uchitha ngaphezu kwale ndiyinikileyo, ndiza kukubuyisela xa ndibuyayo." Ngubani ke kwaba bathathu, ngokubona kwakho, owayengummelwane walowo wawiswe ngamasela?' Waphendula wathi: 'Lowo wamenzela imfesane.' UYesu wathi kuye: 'Hamba, wenze njalo.'

day: Monday of the Twenty-seventh Week in Ordinary Time

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Today marks 100 days without you. Miss you a whole a lot Ben. Feel free to visit any time! See you around buddy! Love you!

Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben,

Rafael Rizzo and his little brother Ben really need your help right now. Please bless them with good health and give them the strength to get through this together. Please watch over Brandon and Flor's health, too.

I miss you a whole bunch. I know you're up in heaven watching over all of us. Whenever you're able to, stop by to visit, yeah? I love you and miss you so much!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben - Miss you a whole bunch. Crying all day yesterday, i hope today will be better. Please guide our family through this grief... There's a 14 year old boy that just left earth on August 12... His name is Phero Aden Vo - look for him, maybe you guys can be friends...

Please pray for me and mom to have good health and strength.

I love and miss you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben, Trustin visited you today and left you a few airplane cards—we're putting them in your room for you. Please pray for Trustin and his family to stay healthy and strong. Be a guardian angel to Trustin and Ryan as they go through school, and help guide their steps through every year to come.
